results.source_text:
theorem gcd_image [DecidableEq β] {g : γ → β} (s : Finset γ) :
    (s.image g).gcd f = s.gcd (f ∘ g) := by
  classical induction s using Finset.induction <;> simp [*]

results.name: Finset.dvd_gcd_iff
results.source_text:
theorem dvd_gcd_iff {a : α} : a ∣ s.gcd f ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, a ∣ f b := by
  apply Iff.trans Multiset.dvd_gcd
  simp only [Multiset.mem_map, and_imp, exists_imp]
  exact ⟨fun k b hb ↦ k _ _ hb rfl, fun k a' b hb h ↦ h ▸ k _ hb⟩

  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/

  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i

/-- `Finset.filter p s` is the set of elements of `s` that satisfy `p`.

For example, one can use `s.filter (· ∈ t)` to get the intersection of `s` with `t : Set α`
as a `Finset α` (when a `DecidablePred (· ∈ t)` instance is available). -/
def filter (s : Finset α) : Finset α :=
  ⟨_, s.2.filter p⟩

    [∀ i, DecidablePred (p i)] :
    (s.sigma t).filter (fun x ↦ p x.fst x.snd) = s.sigma fun i ↦ (t i).filter (p i)  := by
  simp [filter_sigma]

    [DecidablePred p] : (s.sigma t).filter p = s.sigma fun i ↦ (t i).filter fun x => p ⟨i, x⟩ := by
  ext ⟨i, a⟩
  simp [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_sigma, and_assoc]
